name: 负载均衡与实例故障转移
description: Two-step application-tier drill: stop jl-app-1 for 60s, then freeze jl-app-2 for 30s and resume it explicitly at 150s. Product reads keep flowing through Nginx on the remaining instances.

events.title: 停止 app-1
events.text: jl-app-1 停止 60s，Nginx 将流量切到 app-2 / app-3；TTL 到点自动 start。

events.title: 冻结 app-2
events.text: jl-app-2 被 SIGSTOP 冻结 30s，读写请求由 app-1 / app-3 承担；TTL 是恢复保底。

events.title: 恢复 app-2
events.text: 对 jl-app-2 发送 SIGCONT；即使 TTL 已先触发，resume 仍然幂等。
